name: Camping Seespitz Walchsee
beschreibung: Camping Seespitz Walchsee enjoys a dreamlike setting situated directly on the tranquil shores of Lake Walchsee in Tyrol’s scenic Kaiserwinkl region. The campsite is framed by the rugged limestone massifs of the Zahmer and Wilder Kaiser mountains. Guests benefit from direct lake access featuring an extensive sunbathing lawn and private beach area ideal for swimming and watersports. Well-kept pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents blend harmoniously into the landscape. Amenities include clean sanitary facilities, a friendly lakeside kiosk with a sun terrace, and a playground. Scenic hiking and cycling trails start right outside, alongside cross-country ski trails in winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Scenic lakeside campsite right on the shores of Lake Walchsee in Kaiserwinkl with a private beach.
